name: local-ai-chat-frontend
description: A privacy-first, browser-based chat interface for local LLMs (Ollama, GPT4ALL, LM Studio, llama.cpp) and cloud providers. No backend required.
author: hidao80

scripts.quint:typecheck: quint typecheck specs/quint/chat.qnt && quint typecheck specs/quint/chat_test.qnt && quint typecheck specs/quint/settings.qnt && quint typecheck specs/quint/settings_test.qnt
scripts.quint:test: quint test specs/quint/chat_test.qnt --main=chat_test && quint test specs/quint/chat_test.qnt --main=chat_resurrect_test && quint test specs/quint/chat_test.qnt --main=chat_remount_test && quint test specs/quint/settings_test.qnt --main=settings_test && quint test specs/quint/settings_test.qnt --main=settings_no_cancel_test && quint test specs/quint/settings_test.qnt --main=settings_returning_test
scripts.quint:run: quint run specs/quint/chat.qnt --main=chat_fifo --max-steps 25 --max-samples 5000 --verbosity 1 --invariant holds --witnesses wMount wReveal wUnmount wSend wNewChat wClickLoad wClickDelete wDeltaShown wFinish wFinishOffscreen wSaveDone wDeleteDone wLoadDone wLoadPendingSession wLoadAllDone wDeleteLeavesOtherView && quint run specs/quint/settings.qnt --main=settings_returning --max-steps 20 --max-samples 5000 --verbosity 1 --invariant holds --witnesses wSelectProvider wTypeEndpoint wCommitEndpoint wCommitPartial wSetKey wSetSend wSetSaveKeys wLeaveSettings wEnterSettings wToggleTheme wChatSendWithKey wLmNativeRequest wFetchDone wFetchFail wFetchCancelled wSaveWithKeys wSaveWithoutKeys wLoadApplied wKeysStoredWhileOptedOut
